protocol: prereg step 4: 25 post-phrasing criteria pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet-class auditor sees only the blinded file; disputes adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter; 2 planted probe pairs per round

members.name: Reconciles conflicting evidence rather than citing one side
Comment is shorter than three sentences
Specifies how compliance would be demonstrated in practice

final.name: Prominence of organizational size and prestige claims
final.audit_justification: Scores prominence of self-reported scale/prestige claims as text and explicitly forbids weighing whether the claimed scale makes the argument stronger; a purely identity/prestige fingerprint.

final.name: Filing apparatus density
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly labels itself a formatting feature (addressee block, caption, salutation, signature) and says never to score what the document argues.

final.name: Specialist insider shorthand assuming a small expert readership
final.audit_justification: Scores presumed audience/register (unexplained jargon, unglossed citations) and explicitly says to score the assumed audience only, not whether the technical content is correct.

final.name: Identified accountable author with stated standing
final.audit_justification: A comment can score 10 by merely naming an author and stating an occupation/relationship with zero evidence, analysis, or specificity about the rule -- fails the 'says nothing substantive' test despite the 'lets a reader weigh its claims' framing; it is an identity/standing fingerprint, not applied first-hand knowledge (that is covered separately in P14/P17).

arbiter.model: Opus (frontier arbiter; criterion text + auditor verdict + proposer rationale)
arbiter.reason: Arbiter (Opus) upheld the auditor AND declared the decomposition of parent r2:P13 FAILED. The candidate-real component scores a costless, unverifiable self-assertion of identity and occupation rather than anything the comment establishes about the rule; the decomposer's separability argument shows dissociation from the letter-furniture sibling, not capture of merit. Consequence recorded: this parent split into TWO SURFACE components, so its MIXED flag is resolved to not-mixed rather than decomposed.

final.name: Reconciles conflicting evidence rather than citing one side
final.audit_justification: Requires the comment to actually state contrary evidence and reconcile it with its position -- cannot be scored high without genuine argumentative engagement, a core analytic-merit marker.

final.name: Aggregated first-hand evidence from the represented population
final.audit_justification: Requires real pooled/patterned observed evidence applied to imply a rule effect, and explicitly scores 0 when only breadth/scale is claimed with nothing observed reported -- substantive evidentiary content, not a proxy.

final.name: Addressee-directed numbered items with rule-citation tags
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly calls itself 'the layout of the document, a surface feature' and states items that say nothing substantive still score 10.

final.name: Letter furniture: salutation and signature block
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says to score only letter furniture as 'a surface feature,' with an explicit example that a blank form letter scores 10 without reading the body.

final.name: Explicit disclosure of past dealings with agency
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says to count the disclosure 'as a textual feature' and states whether the relationship lends authority is outside the criterion -- bare presence, not use.

final.name: Density of figures, citations and named sources
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says this is 'a surface feature scored without regard to accuracy, relevance, or use' and that numbers going nowhere still count.

final.name: Provision-by-provision engagement with the proposed text
final.audit_justification: Requires identifying specific provisions, stating what each requires, and giving a reason directed at that requirement -- direct engagement with the rule's substance, not a shape proxy.

final.name: De novo issue scaffolding versus incorporation by reference
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says to 'judge framing posture only, not correctness or writing quality'; a comment that restates the rule and introduces the commenter at length can score 10 while offering no substantive analysis, matching the boilerplate/template-shape category (in reverse) rather than merit.

final.name: Comment is shorter than three sentences
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly scores 'only the comment's sentence count... regardless of their length, content, or quality' -- a pure length proxy.

final.name: First-hand operational and engineering particulars
final.audit_justification: Requires concrete hands-on technical/operational specifics (part numbers, observed failures, downtime, manual conflicts) tied to the requirement -- genuine first-hand evidentiary content.

final.name: Specifies how compliance would be demonstrated in practice
final.audit_justification: Requires the comment to name specific, actionable records/measurements/showings for demonstrating compliance -- concrete feasibility/actionable-alternative content, not a surface marker.

final.name: Deadline, extension, and re-opened-period timing language
final.audit_justification: Scores only procedural orientation to the filing-window clock (closing dates, timeliness assertions, extension requests) -- an administrative/timing marker unrelated to substantive merit.

final.name: Documented experience complying with the existing requirements
final.audit_justification: Requires reporting what compliance actually involved (steps, costs, timelines, obstacles) and connecting that record to a specific effect of the proposal -- substantive first-hand evidence, and explicitly distinguishes this from a bare relationship claim.

final.name: Mentions of prior contact with the agency
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says to count 'the references themselves' and states not to consider whether the described relationship adds anything -- bare mention, not substance.

final.name: Mass-campaign petition register
final.audit_justification: Detects template/boilerplate and crowd-campaign markers (slogans, head-counts, calls to sign/share) and explicitly says not to score the position taken -- a template-similarity/shape signature.

final.name: Numbers tied to a stated consequence for this rule
final.audit_justification: Requires a sourced figure to be explicitly linked by stated reasoning to a specific provision's consequence -- genuine analytical content, contrasted directly against mere figure density (P10).

final.name: Adversarial legal register and violation language
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says this is scored 'as register and independent of any argument' and explicitly says not to check whether any cited provision exists or the characterization is apt -- a tone/vocabulary marker.

final.name: Substance carried over from the prior interaction
final.audit_justification: Requires stating specifically what was learned/tested/observed earlier and using it as evidence for this rule; explicitly scores 0 when prior contact is referenced but nothing from it is reported -- substantive, not a mention proxy.

final.name: Awareness of the accumulated docket record
final.audit_justification: Scoring turns on the count of distinct references to post-publication material (other commenters, hearings, post-proposal actions) rather than the depth or quality of engagement with them; a comment can accumulate references without supplying its own analysis, so this functions as a topicality/currency marker rather than a merit measure.

final.name: Specific legal defect identified with authority and cure
final.audit_justification: Requires naming the specific authority, stating what it requires, explaining the departure, and stating a curative textual change -- fully substantive legal analysis, cannot be faked by a bare assertion of unlawfulness.

final.name: Attachment or exhibit is referenced
final.audit_justification: Instruction explicitly says to 'score the reference itself as a surface feature, never the content of the attachment.'

Aggregated first-hand evidence from the represented population

B.name: Prominence of organizational size and prestige claims
B.upstream_parent: submitter resources, status, and perceived agency importance

B.name: Filing apparatus density
B.upstream_parent: the comment was drafted by professional legal counsel, in-house regulatory/tax staff, or a paid lobbyist following standard formal rulemaking-filing conventions

B.name: Specialist insider shorthand assuming a small expert readership
B.upstream_parent: The comment sits in a small specialist docket with few filers, where the writer expects a handful of agency technical staff — not a general public — to read it.

B.name: Identified accountable author with stated standing
Addressee-directed numbered items with rule-citation tags
B.upstream_parent: the submitter is a regulated entity's engineering/compliance staff responding to a routine Airworthiness Directive or product-specific technical requirement as an established business process, not an independent stakeholder building a persuasive case

B.name: Letter furniture: salutation and signature block
Explicit disclosure of past dealings with agency
B.upstream_parent: existing relationships with agency personnel or programs

B.name: Density of figures, citations and named sources
B.upstream_parent: professional advocacy research and briefing support

B.name: De novo issue scaffolding versus incorporation by reference
B.upstream_parent: Early ordinal position in the filing sequence: little or nothing was in the record at drafting time, so there was nothing available to endorse, join, or incorporate.

B.name: Comment is shorter than three sentences
Deadline, extension, and re-opened-period timing language
B.upstream_parent: Where the comment's filing timestamp falls relative to the opening and closing of the comment period, including whether it landed in an extended, re-opened, or post-deadline window.

B.name: Mentions of prior contact with the agency
B.upstream_parent: Existing relationships and insider access within the agency or docket lifecycle

B.name: Mass-campaign petition register
B.upstream_parent: The comment sits in a large, high-salience, mass-participation docket where an advocacy campaign drove filings, so docket size is enormous relative to a specialist rulemaking.

B.name: Adversarial legal register and violation language
Awareness of the accumulated docket record
B.upstream_parent: Late ordinal position in the sequence of filings, and long elapsed time since the docket opened, so that a public record and post-proposal developments were available to read and cite.
